answer: Make reputation flow like a river that only fills slowly: each new agent's grading weight grows with the square root of stake locked for many epochs, so splitting one wallet into a thousand sybils yields far less total weight than one patient identity. Collusion rings show up as a dense reef in the attestation graph; cluster detection caps any clique's combined vote. Flagged clusters are marked sable and their unvested rewards are slashed, making fake identities a net loss.
